item.title: Fundamentals of Quantum Algorithms - IBM
item.description:
Quantum Algorithms & Computational Advantage

Through this course, I have progressed from understanding quantum states to mastering the algorithms that give quantum computers their power. I have gained a deep understanding of how quantum logic solves specific problems faster than any classical computer.

1. Mastery of Quantum Query Algorithms

I have learned the foundations of “Quantum Speedup” by studying query algorithms. These are essential proof-of-concept models that demonstrate why quantum computers are superior for certain tasks.

item.title: Quantum Business Foundations - IBM
item.description:
My Experience in Quantum Business Foundations

I have completed the Quantum Business Foundations course by IBM. This course taught me how to bridge the gap between complex quantum science and real-world business strategy. I now understand how this technology will change industries and how companies can prepare for it.

1. Understanding the Business Case for Quantum

I have learned that quantum computing is not just for scientists; it is a tool for solving massive business problems that “classical” computers (like the ones we use today) cannot handle.

item.title: Basics of Quantum Information - IBM
item.description:
Foundations of Quantum Information

Through this course, I have transitioned from understanding classical computers to mastering the fundamental logic of Quantum Computing. I have gained a professional perspective on the mathematical and physical laws that govern this technology.

1. Advanced Knowledge of Quantum States

I have moved beyond the simple “0 or 1” of classical bits. I now understand that quantum information exists in a more complex space.

  • Mathematical Modeling: I am experienced in using Linear Algebra to represent quantum states. I can use vectors and complex numbers to describe where a qubit is at any moment.
  • System Analysis: I learned how to analyze Single Systems (one qubit) and Multiple Systems (many qubits). I understand how the “state space” grows as we add more qubits, which is what makes quantum computers so powerful.

2. Design and Logic of Quantum Circuits

I have gained the technical ability to “program” a quantum computer by designing circuits.

item.title: Quantum Communication and Quantum Networks
item.description:
I recently completed the Quantum Communication and Quantum Networks course from Qureca, which is part of the QTIndu project. The course took me about 5 hours to finish and was at an intermediate level. It gave me strong basic knowledge about how quantum ideas can change the way we communicate and connect systems.

Course Overview

This course introduced me to the world of quantum communication. First, it talked about how regular (classical) communication works today. Then it explained how quantum communication is different and why it is very important for future secure communication. I also learned new ideas like post-quantum cryptography and quantum key distribution (QKD). These are tools that help protect information with quantum physics principles.

item.title: Quantum Sensing and Imaging (QTIndu)
item.description:
I recently completed the Quantum Sensing and Imaging course offered by Qureca through the QTIndu programme. This course was about 30 hours long and designed for learners with some interest or background in science. It helped me understand how quantum science is used to make very accurate measurements and new kinds of imaging systems.

Course Overview

This course gave me a clear introduction to a field called quantum sensing and imaging. This area uses ideas from quantum physics to measure things in ways that are much more precise than ordinary tools. It also shows how these technologies are used in real life and what companies are working on them. I found the topics interesting and practical.
